name: Kajiba Isuzu
source:
She is the older of the two daughters of the main character. She is a talented and accomplished, but her cooking is her only weakness.

She is an honor student and the president of the student council. She is looked up to by the other students.

Her father's outburst begins when she receives a proposal to marry the son of an influential man.
